ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels, roughly 0.15:1 ratio across visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black background with high-contrast white linear streaks concentrated in the central-left and right-middle regions; high-intensity white clusters at the distal tips; sparse white speckling across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude peaks at the distal tips (barnacle encrustation) and moderate serration across the mid-lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to narrow, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense circular high-contrast pixel clusters at the terminal tips of both lobes; scattered singular white circular spots (speckling) across the main body of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent parallel white linear markings (rake marks) extending diagonally across the left lobe and vertically on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel scars) on both lobes and heavy barnacle colonization at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white calcified texture at the distal tips creates a unique, jagged profile distinct from the natural fluke edge.
